question: How many users are there in each age category (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others)?
sql:
WITH user_ages AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        birth_date,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) as year_diff,
        CAST(strftime('%m', CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) as current_month,
        CAST(strftime('%d', CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) as current_day,
        CAST(strftime('%m', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) as birth_month,
        CAST(strftime('%d', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) as birth_day
    FROM mst_users
),
user_age_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        birth_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN current_month > birth_month OR (current_month = birth_month AND current_day >= birth_day) THEN year_diff
            ELSE year_diff - 1
        END as actual_age
    FROM user_ages
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN actual_age >= 20 AND actual_age <= 29 THEN '20s'
        WHEN actual_age >= 30 AND actual_age <= 39 THEN '30s'
        WHEN actual_age >= 40 AND actual_age <= 49 THEN '40s'
        WHEN actual_age >= 50 AND actual_age <= 59 THEN '50s'
        ELSE 'others'
    END as age_category,
    MIN(actual_age) as min_age,
    MAX(actual_age) as max_age,
    COUNT(*) as user_count
FROM user_age_calc
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY 
    CASE age_category
        WHEN '20s' THEN 1
        WHEN '30s' THEN 2
        WHEN '40s' THEN 3
        WHEN '50s' THEN 4
        WHEN 'others' THEN 5
    END
